TURF.HOW_TO_PLAY: > **To play this game after pre-startup**, it's as simple as just clicking the buttons to recolor them! Whoever has the **most recolored buttons** in their chosen color when the match ends will win!
TURF.INTERACTION_FAILED:
> **In any time of which you see a message along the lines of `interaction failed`**, it does not mean you can't keep going! This can happen if you click the buttons too quickly but the game should still work in general.
> **If you're having too much trouble**, consider making a bug report with details just in case it's something that needs to be fixed!
